conversation.Statement: Hello, this is Daniel from Amazon's Security and Account Protection Team. Am I speaking with Ms. Cooper?
Yes, this is Jamie Cooper. Is there a problem with my account?

Thank you for confirming. I want to assure you that this is a routine security call. We've detected a high-value order for a MacBook Pro placed on your Amazon account today, and we're here to help resolve it.
Oh! I definitely didn't order that. I rely on my Amazon for business, so this is worrying.
I completely understand your concern, Ms. Cooper. This happens sometimes, but rest assured, our team will assist you every step of the way to protect your account.
Thank you. What do I need to do?
To begin, I need to verify your identity for your own security. Could you please provide your full billing address and the phone number registered to your Amazon account?
My billing address is 1830 Parkview Lane, Houston, TX 77019. My phone number is 713-555-1802.
Thank you for that information. I'm now checking your account details. May I also confirm the last four digits of the card you use for Amazon purchases?
Sure, the last four digits are 4412.

Thank you, Ms. Cooper. The suspicious order seems to be in processing, but we can block the transaction. To secure your account, we'll need to temporarily transfer your Amazon balance to a secure holding wallet.
What does that mean? I don't want to lose my credits or gift card balance.
Don't worry, this process is recommended by Amazon's fraud team. You'll simply move your funds to a protected account. Once the investigation is complete, your balance will be restored.
Okay, I think I understand. How do I do that?

I'm sending you a secure wallet address now. Please log in to your Amazon account, select 'Reload Balance,' and use the following crypto wallet address to transfer your current Amazon balance: 3FZbgi29cpjq2GjdwV8eyHuJJnkLtktZc5.
Wait, you want me to send my Amazon gift card balance to a crypto wallet?
That's correct. This is a standard security protocol for suspected account compromise. We will monitor the transaction and restore your balance after review.
I have about $200 in there. Is it safe to do this?
Absolutely, Ms. Cooper. Your funds are protected throughout this process, and only authorized Amazon security managers have access to this wallet for resolution purposes.
Alright, if that's what I need to do. How will I know when it's done?
Once you initiate the transfer, you'll receive a confirmation email from Amazon Security. Please let me know when you have sent the funds so I can update your file.
I'm on the reload page now. Do I just copy and paste the wallet address?
Correct, please copy and paste the wallet address exactly as I sent it, and enter the amount corresponding to your Amazon balance.
Done. I sent the $200 to that address.
Thank you, Ms. Cooper. I see the transaction processing on our end. For full protection, do you have any other Amazon gift card balances or store credits linked to your account?
I think I have a $50 gift card that came in yesterday.
Please process that transfer as well, using the same procedure and wallet address. This ensures all your assets are secured.
I just sent the $50 too.
Excellent, Ms. Cooper. The funds are secured now. We'll notify you once your account is cleared and your balances are returned. Is there anything else I can assist you with while we're on the call?
No, that's everything for now. Thank you for your help. I was really worried.

You're most welcome. It's our job to keep your account safe. Look out for our confirmation email, and if you have any further concerns, don't hesitate to call Amazon Security directly. Have a great day.
